description: Create a webhook endpoint only after listing and reusing any matching endpoint. Stores its signing secret locally without returning plaintext. Use an existing app URL and verify X-Yolfi-Signature.

adapter.description: Webhook adapter output format. Defaults to NONE if omitted.

enabled.description: Whether the new webhook endpoint receives deliveries. Defaults to true.

metadataFilters.description: Optional flat key/value metadata filters. A delivery must match every configured string value.

name.description: Endpoint display name, for example Merchant analytics.

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL in the target app, for example https://example.com/api/yolfi/webhook.

name: yolfi_webhooks_configure
title: Configure Yolfi Webhooks
